checks: Concise doctor profile discloses its bio and opens a separate date/time step
Changing date clears time; editing review/back preserves the chosen schedule and draft
Schedule selection fits small, wide and landscape viewports
A fully occupied day is disabled and the first available day is selected
No available day cannot advance to a false booking review
Schedule load failure blocks review and retry restores actual available slots
Time labels and day-part groups follow the slot timezone instead of the device timezone
A late schedule response for a previous doctor cannot replace the current doctor slots
Clinical appointments remain unchanged and no uncaught page errors occur
scope: Doctor profile/schedule UI; real local API plus controlled slot responses; no reservation created
